name: Pajama Incubus Party
source:
In a cozy town built around an old academy of witchcraft, the school year has just ended, and a new class of witches has just been sent out into the world.

But the academy they've just graduated from is one built on centuries of tradition, cloistering away its students throughout their whole educations, teaching them the mystical arts in the manner of days long past. The students raised within its halls have a tendency to come out skilled in the ways of witchcraft, but hungry for any outside experience. And, more than a little pent up.

Four friends, released from the shackles of the academy, decide to celebrate their newfound freedom the best way they know how...
